visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing black-framed glasses and a black graphic t-shirt, is meticulously picking through the hair of a young girl. The girl is wearing her hair in pigtails and a bright pink shirt. They are in a well-lit indoor domestic setting. (2) A young girl with short dark hair is crawling on a wooden floor. She is wearing a brown and white checkered romper with yellow shorts. A green balloon animal shaped like a dog sits on the floor near her. (3) The man leans over the girl in the pink shirt, using his hands to mimic a grooming motion near her neck and shoulders, while she giggles and looks back at him. (4) The young girl in the checkered outfit is sitting on the floor, playing with various toys and another green balloon animal. The background shows a modern living room with large windows. (5) The man continues his playful grooming, leaning in very close to the girl's neck as if searching for something, while she leans her head away with a smile. (6) A simple animated screen appears with two cartoon characters representing the father and daughter, alongside the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' on a pale yellow background.
